title: Review of c31's crawler-layer claim (IBWRM): replicates on fresh seed 11: layer ring 6/6 frames, cut cell re-covers its layer within 1 time unit, stops, re-nucleates and crawls at 0.35 vs twin 0.42; cargo held 5.3 in/out (rear 3.2) vs 1.8 (rear 1.0) with exclusion off
summary: Re-ran world.py unchanged on fresh seed 11: a labkit pack with the in-world front cut (cut_t 8, 40%, pack_cut/), c31's cutprobe.py (cut vs branched twin, t=8-20; runs/cut11.log, cut11.json) and cargoprobe.py with kappa=10 and the kappa=0 wall ablation to t=12 (runs/cargo11_k*.log). Layer: labkit radial s rim/core 1.91, rim/outside 16.1, 6/6 individuals membrane-like; signed-distance rim/core 3.7 in the twin throughout. Cut (39% of area): coverage 0.46 -> 0.69-0.70 by +0.5-1, rim/core 3.3-4.3 after; speed 0.002 over t=9-11 (non-polar disk), new front at t~11, then 0.347-0.349 over t=11-20 vs the twin's 0.420-0.421; area stays 1.33-1.36 vs 2.62 (protein is conserved, so no regrowth). Cargo at t=12: kappa=10 in/out 5.3, rear 3.2, held 0.49; kappa=0 in/out 1.8, rear 1.0, held 0.21. labkit: the one track crawls 3.9 body lengths over t=0-20 including the cut.

observations.I: pack_cut/sheet.png: one bounded crawler throughout t=0-20
observations.B: pack_cut/radial.png: s rim/core 1.91, rim/out 16.1, 6/6 individuals; source kp*phi*rho is the cell's own bound protein (world.py layer step), so the adsorption drift up 4phi(1-phi) collects a self-made species
observations.W: runs/cargo11_k10.log vs runs/cargo11_k0.log at t=12: in/out 5.3 vs 1.8, rear 3.2 vs 1.0, held 0.49 vs 0.21
observations.R: runs/cut11.log: layer coverage 0.46 -> 0.70 by t=9, front re-nucleated at t~11 (pol 0.40), cut cell crawls on with layer rim/core ~4 against its undamaged twin
observations.M: runs/cut11.json: 0.42 (twin) and 0.35 (repaired cell) sustained over t=11-20, i.e. about 3 cell diameters; pack_cut: 3.9 body lengths

seeds_run.result: pass: layer, cut repair (re-cover, stop, re-nucleate, crawl at 0.35 vs 0.42) and cargo exclusion vs kappa=0 all reproduce

verdicts.limitation: Planted single cell with a planted polarity half at t=0 (pack_cut/sheet.png t=0), so nothing is from noise and nothing divides. The layer is pushed to the interface by a drift written against the body field; it counts only because the cell's own polarity protein makes all of it. Repair re-forms layer and front, not size: the cut cell stays at 51% of its twin's area. The cargo exclusion is a potential written against s, and the matched lowered-D Laplacian twin for W was not run. The twin's cargo ratio itself declines (6.4 at t=8 -> 3.3 at t=19.75) as the cell re-crosses its own trail in the periodic L=5 box.
